evidence_quotes:
All vehicle shortcomings will be reported on DA Form 2404 Equipment Inspection and Maintenance
Worksheet or DA Form 5988-E (automated) (DA Pam 738-750) immediately after the PMCS, and before
taking corrective action.
statements.reason: The context specifies DA Form 2404 or DA Form 5988-E, not Form 300.
statements.statement: When loose starter mounting bolts are found during PMCS, the shortcoming is reported using Form 300 (Maintenance Report).

evidence_quotes:
All vehicle shortcomings will be reported on DA Form 2404 Equipment Inspection and Maintenance
Worksheet or DA Form 5988-E (automated) (DA Pam 738-750) immediately after the PMCS, and before
taking corrective action.
statements.reason: The context requires reporting immediately after PMCS and before corrective action; it does not specify a 24-hour deadline from detection.
statements.statement: When loose starter mounting bolts are found during PMCS, the shortcoming must be reported within 24 hours of detection.

evidence_quotes:
a. Inspect starter for mounting
security. Tighten mounting bolts to
40 lb-ft (54 N•m).
statements.reason: The starter inspection procedure specifies 40 lb-ft, not 15 ft-lbs.
statements.statement: For starter mounting bolts found loose during PMCS, the specified tightening torque is 15 ft-lbs.
